title: Buy 5 properties
detail: Any five for-sale houses or businesses. The Vanilla Unicorn and plain garages do not count.

detail: Legendary Motorsport, Southern San Andreas Super Autos, Warstock, or Elitas.

title: Yoga session
detail: The story mission is already on the 100% list. This box is a later session at Michael's house, poses included.

detail: 100% only needs one finished round. This box is a 9-hole round at even par or better.

title: Tennis set
detail: 100% only needs one game. This box is a full set.

title: Darts checkout
detail: 100% only needs one game. This box is a checkout from 501.

title: Flight School gold medals
detail: 100% only needs any medal on each of the 12 lessons. This box is gold on all 12.

title: BAWSAQ and LCN accounts
detail: Open both in-game broker sites. Not part of the 100% score.

title: Lester assassination portfolio
detail: Hold the related stock through one of Lester's assassination missions, then sell after the price moves. Mark it yourself. This is a story milestone, not a live market feed.
